opening hours rathdowney: tuesday, wednesday, thursday 9.30am - 2pm & friday 9.30am - ipm durrow: wednesday, thursday & friday 10 am to 2 pm ireland's 3rd national first saturdays conference this year's conference will take place in knock on saturday november 28th. the day begins at 10am and finishes at 5pm. it includes holy mass, adoration, talks, and a healing service. speakers include: fr patrick cahill, geraldine o'donnell, fr leon pereira op, nikki kingsley, fr marius o'reilly, fr. jaimie twohig, christine o'hara, fr. mark quinn, and fr philip kemmy, fr. john keane will lead a eucharistic healing service. more information and the list of buses going are available on

. at fatima our lady promised that if we did what she asked there would be peace in the world and that many souls would be saved. volunteer drivers ní the irish cancer society is seeking compassionate volunteer drivers to join our pool of drivers. as a volunteer driver you would be bringing patients undergoing chemotherapy to the hospital and back home for their treatment. gifting your time means that cancer patients will have comfortable (one on one) transport to attend appointments for their lifesaving treatment. if you can spare 2 days per month, have a valid driving licence, and a safe, reliable vehicle, you are the perfect candidate to make a significant difference. the irish cancer society will provide you with training before you start as a driver for us. your generosity not only eases the journey for many during a challenging time but also offers comfort and support when it's needed most. for more information and to become a volunteer driver, please contact monica or emily at

the feedback we receive from patients that have relied on the transport service in the past is heart-warming and underlines the need of its existence. we would be extremely grateful for your support, as it will help us to continue supporting those who are impacted by cancer
